title: Curious
content: I have an awful memory, but since maybe kindergarten I have had a reoccurring dream. I don’t have very many details and it happens randomly. All I really remember is a MASSIVE clown or maybe Jack in the box style toy, checkerboard floors or walls and a creepy and ominous feeling. The biggest takeaway is feeling like I need to run for my life every single time I have that dream. Does anyone else have any dream similar to this? Ive had other “mallworld” esque dreams that reoccur in theme but this is the only one where I know the events occur exactly the same each time but I just can’t remember them, even though I’ve had this dream for almost 2 decades.
